details.text: A Schengen visa is for a short, temporary visit of up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
The visa fee is €90 for adults and €45 for children aged 6-12. An extra fee may apply if you apply through a visa service centre.
Normal processing time is 15 days. It can be extended to up to 45 days if a closer look or extra documents are needed.
If your application is refused, you will be told why it was refused and how to appeal.
